dashboard.label: Preserve Viewport on Refresh (Test)
dashboard.description: Acceptance test for GitHub #63 — panel search auto-refresh vs Maps+ viewport behavior. Requires Maps+ 4.6.9+.

html.p: Splunk re-runs the panel search on a timer when <refresh> is set inside the panel's <search> block (not on a separate base search). Both maps below use <refresh>10s</refresh> with <refreshType>delay</refreshType> (next run starts 10 seconds after the previous run finishes).

Static lookups like chicago-crime.csv do not change between refreshes, so the map can look unchanged even when it did re-render. This dashboard rotates which crimes are shown every 10 seconds and updates the Refresh heartbeat panel so you can confirm the search is re-running.

ol.li: Wait for the first load — both maps auto-fit to Chicago.
Zoom into a neighborhood on each map (cluster breaks apart above zoom 14).
Wait for at least one 10s refresh cycle.
Left map (Preserve Viewport Disabled, default): viewport should snap back to the full-city fit on every refresh.
Right map (Preserve Viewport Enabled): viewport should stay where you left it; markers and the beacon tooltip update in place.
Right-click either map → Auto Fit & Zoom to re-center manually.

html.p: If nothing updates, confirm you installed Maps+ 4.6.9+, open this dashboard from Classic (Simple XML) view (not Dashboard Studio), and check that the heartbeat timestamp below changes every ~10 seconds.

search.query: | makeresults count=1 | eval last_refresh=strftime(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') | eval cycle=floor(now()/10) % 6 | eval cycle_label=case(cycle=0,"A", cycle=1,"B", cycle=2,"C", cycle=3,"D", cycle=4,"E", 1=1,"F") | table last_refresh, cycle, cycle_label

panel.title: Default — Preserve Viewport Disabled (re-fits every refresh)
